2026.headline: Back to 2-2 and still searching for a quarterback
story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them. He is 2-2 with 530.88 points and sits 6th, up one spot.

The losses were close. 113.10 to 127.06 against YesChef23 in Week 1, and 127.74 to 139.80 against Hades9mm in Week 3. The wins were a 156.16 to 110.60 beat-down of Sarge71 in Week 2 and a 133.88 to 121.78 win over C33DeezNutzz in Week 4, with Taylor leading at 22.7, despite 30.4 points on the bench.

The quarterback room is the open question. Aaron Rodgers arrived as an autopick, was moved to free agency, and the Week 3 move was a swap involving Drew Lock and Geno Smith. Week 4 brought Kyler Murray, cut by StealingGas earlier in the week, for Boutte. The 8th pick on MAXPF says the roster has a good best case, and the record says it is finally being realized.
takes: Jonathan Taylor did the real work.
The Issue 1 No. 1 label is a lot to carry, but it is lighter at 2-2.
